title: EVA-03 instance per job
goal: A fresh EVA-03 instance per job with the chosen mechanism, discarded afterwards; the tools process moves into it so EVA-03 grants can run
acceptance: Create, run and discard per job; no state carried between jobs
Mounts, network, credentials, deadline and cancellation as T01 specifies
Failed attempts and uncertain external effects stay in the ledger; discard never claims rollback
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
validation: Unit and join tests; npm test
escalation: New upstream API work belongs to its owning repository; NERV supplies adapters

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-14 from 0.5 h to 0.75 h: feature implementation steps closed since 2026-11-13 took 0.75–1 h (F-066-T01, F-066-T02, F-062-T03, F-044-T01) where the 0.25x pass had set 0.25–1 h; started from this step's estimate, not a ratio.
